| description = 

:You say, 'Hail Evus Doracmal'

Evus Doracmal says, 'Good day. ____! Have you visited Taria already? Taria does indeed make some of the finest statuettes in all the land. I fear. though. that she has lost her faith. She used to make idols depicting our Lord of Fear. Now she dabbles in the creation of [other idols]!

:You say, 'What other idols?'

Evus Doracmal says, 'Well. just the other day. she was commissioned to create a representation of Tunare for Iva down at the Bakery. I've always known that Iva was a bit odd. but that is just downright strange!'
